title: SaaS MRR & Churn Dashboard - Google Sheets & Excel Spreadsheet Template
description: Type four numbers a month and this spreadsheet computes the rest: MRR, ARR, gross churn, net revenue retention, average net MRR added, a twelve-month table, an MRR chart, and how many months you are from your ARR target. Formula-only - no macros, no scripts, nothing locked, every formula visible and editable. Works in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel. Instant download of three files, including a free guide that puts the same dashboard on your phone, running privately in your own Google account.
